Authorization is only checked later via `can_edit_alert_rule`, which validates scopes but does not confirm ownership of the rule or that the rule belongs to a project the user can view, allowing IDOR.

evidence.content: Permission class is applied to the endpoint, but it only checks project‑level scopes, not per‑object ownership.

findings.suggested_fix: Add an object‑level permission check after retrieving the rule to ensure the user is authorized to view or modify that specific rule (e.g., verify rule.project belongs to a project the user has access to, or use a dedicated permission class that checks rule ownership).
